{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_31",
      "title": "Ensure VNET subnet is configured with a Network Security Group (NSG)",
      "resource": "azurerm_subnet.private_subnet",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The subnet is not associated with a Network Security Group (NSG), which is necessary to control inbound and outbound traffic and enhance network security."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource "azurerm_subnet" "private_subnet" {
  name                 = "smart-manufacturing-iot-monitoring-platform-subnet-private"
  resource_group_name  = azurerm_resource_group.smart_manufacturing.name
  virtual_network_name = azurerm_virtual_network.smart_manufacturing_vnet.name
  address_prefixes     = ["10.0.2.0/24"]
  security_group       = azurerm_network_security_group.private_subnet_nsg.id
}

resource "azurerm_network_security_group" "private_subnet_nsg" {
  name                = "private-subnet-nsg"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.smart_manufacturing.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.smart_manufacturing.name

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowInternalTraffic"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "10.0.0.0/16"
    destination_address_prefix = "10.0.0.0/16"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyAllInbound"
    priority                   = 200
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "*"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowAllOutbound"
    priority                   = 100
    direction                  = "Outbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "*"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }
}",
  "fix_summary": "Added a Network Security Group (NSG) to the subnet to control traffic and enhance security. Associated the NSG with the subnet and defined basic security rules for internal traffic, denying all other inbound traffic, and allowing all outbound traffic."
}
